subject: INLA crashing when running code from case studies

messages.author: a288fef9e5d6df45
messages.subject: INLA crashing when running code from case studies
parts:
Hi,

I have very little experience with this package so far, so I thought I would try and work through a case study. The code I've been trying is this one (DICs.R):
http://www.r-inla.org/examples/case-studies/cosandey-godin-krainski-worm-and-mills-flemming-2014

All the data and the the code are available on that page; the only thing I've changed is the working directory. When running the inla() function, I receive the following error:

Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : 
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does help; please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>. 

I don't know how to interpret this and what could cause it. I have not changed the code, so the verbose argument=T. I'm using R 3.2 with R Studio on Yosemite 10.10. If anyone has any thoughts on this I would much appreciate hearing it!

Kind regards and thank you very much,

Max

messages.author: 4fa871340492c9c0
messages.subject: Re: INLA crashing when running code from case studies
parts:
Hi Max,

Some of these models are quiet large and were runned on a cluster machine. I re-ran most of them yesterday and did not encounter any issues. You are most likely having memory issues.

If you have access to a remote cluster, have a look at: http://www.r-inla.org/faq#TOC-I-have-access-to-a-remote-Linux-server-is-it-possible-to-run-the-computations-remotely-and-running-R-locally-

Note also that all of the models are here fitted with the 'Laplace' approximation (takes longer) which is not the default in INLA - uses the simplified Laplace. You may try to run some of these models again with the simplified Laplace (just comment out control.inla=list(strategy='laplace')).
If you are just interested in testing the models/codes, you can also reduce the size of the models by using a sample of the data.

Cheers,

Aurelie

messages.subject: Re: INLA crashing when running code from case studies
parts:
Hi Max,
I was able to run these models about 2 weeks ago pretty quickly on a intel 8 core i7 16G of ram on 64 bit Windows OS. I also ran the script on my laptop and it took forever. It's a HP Notebook AMD quad core A8 8G of ram. Maybe play around with the threading setting? I think Aurelie was threading by 8 in that script. This might not be beneficial for a 4 core machine...
Good luck
Robby

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: INLA crashing when running code from case studies

It sounds like it used up all your memory on the laptop.
Reducing the number of threads should help, yes. (Try 2, if that doesn't work, try 1. If 2works, try 3, then 4...)

Finn
